# Bitly and Salesforce Integration

Create and track branded short links directly within Salesforce. Measure engagement across every campaign and customer touchpoint without leaving your CRM.

[Get started for free](https://bitly.com/pages/pricing)

## What you can do with Bitly and Salesforce

- Generate [branded short links](https://bitly.com/pages/features/branded-links) for campaigns, emails, and outreach directly in Salesforce.
- Track click data and [engagement metrics](https://bitly.com/blog/short-link-tracking-analytics/) alongside your customer records.
- Attribute link performance to specific leads, contacts, and opportunities.
- Centralize your marketing and sales link activity in one platform.

![Shorten a link with Bitly in Salesforce](https://s49244.pcdn.co/pseo/template-assets/bitly-integrations-feature-01.webp)

## How Bitly works with Salesforce

Native integration

The Bitly and Salesforce integration connects directly to your CRM. Start creating and tracking branded links in minutes with no additional tools required.

- Access Bitly link creation and management from within Salesforce records.
- Sync click and engagement data automatically to your CRM.
- Apply consistent branding to every link shared by your sales and marketing teams.

## Limitations and considerations

* * *

- Some advanced analytics features require a paid Bitly plan.

- Custom branded domains are available on Bitly paid plans.

- Link volume limits may apply depending on your Bitly subscription tier.

- Initial setup requires admin access to both Bitly and Salesforce.

## Bitly and Salesforce integration FAQs

Is the Bitly and Salesforce integration free?

You can connect Bitly to Salesforce with a free Bitly account. Advanced features like detailed analytics and custom branded domains require a paid Bitly plan.

What Salesforce editions support the Bitly integration?

The Bitly integration works with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Check the Bitly Marketplace for the latest compatibility details.

Can I track link clicks at the contact or lead level?

Yes. The integration allows you to associate link engagement data with specific Salesforce records, so you can see which contacts and leads interact with your content.

Do I need technical expertise to set up the integration?

No coding is required. The native integration connects through the Bitly Marketplace and can be configured by any Salesforce admin in minutes.

Can my team share branded links with a custom domain?

Custom branded domains are available on Bitly paid plans. Once configured, your team can create links with your brand's domain directly in Salesforce.
